applied.problem: "Divide the two sides, then press the inverse key" does not work as written on common natural-display calculators, where sin⁻¹ opens a bracket that needs the ratio inside it; keying sin⁻¹(6 ÷ 10) works on any of them.

Says answers are rounded to one decimal place, but the lesson also shows 1.67, 0.7071, 1.414, 0.866, 24° and 66°, and 13.4957° deliberately unrounded, so the blanket rule is not true of its own figures.
